what: The big wordmark’s letters bounce vertically like a VU meter — on first appearance they rise once at 1.0–1.2x and settle in two beats, the faster the scroll the higher each letter rises differently, and letters near the cursor swell in a bell curve up to 1.14x

options.bpm: Tempo speed — all lengths are in beats, so this one value changes the rhythm together, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
